what_to_monitor.why: Watch for any escalation in tensions, particularly around the Strait of Hormuz [1], [9]. Increased tensions could significantly disrupt supply and raise PET prices. Procurement strategies should include contingency plans for unexpected supply shocks.

Monitor oil prices closely as they directly impact the cost of PET production. Any rise in oil costs will translate to higher PET prices. Buyers should consider long-term contracts or hedging strategies to mitigate price volatility.

New EU regulations [6], [8] could lead to increased production costs and supply disruptions. Watch for updates on these policies, which may require adjustments in procurement strategies to remain compliant.

Keep an eye on anti-dumping investigations, particularly in Vietnam and China [7]. If these investigations lead to tariffs or import restrictions, they will increase PET prices. Strategic procurement may involve diversifying supply chains to mitigate these impacts.
